links.comparator_used: Same radiologists' screening mammography interpretation before introduction of the AI workflow (no AI, no Safeguard Review); not a standard two-radiologist double-reading comparison
links.outcome: Cancer detection rate and PPV of recalls in generalists and specialists
links.effect: Generalists: CDR 3.76 to 4.99 per 1000 (P<.001); PPV of recalls 3.38% to 3.89% (P=.02). Specialists: CDR 4.47 to 4.76 per 1000 (P=.33), no change in PPV (P=.86). Generalist CDR with AI was similar to specialists (P=.53).
links.tradeoff: Recall rate rose among generalists by 14.79% relative (9.06% to 10.40%, P=.007).
links.quote: A multistage AI-driven workflow was associated with substantially improved CDR and PPV of recalls for generalists, which were on par with those of specialists.

design_hint: Safeguard Review routing AI-flagged non-recalled mammograms to expert review
